description: This file defines the ConfigurationProvider class in the AWS SDK for PHP, responsible for providing and managing retry configuration settings via various providers such as environment variables, configuration files, and fallback defaults. It includes methods for creating default providers, environment-based providers, file-based providers, and unwrapping configuration objects. The class supports composing multiple providers and caching configurations.

classes.name: ConfigurationProvider
classes.description: Provides retry configurations by combining environment variables, config files, and defaults with support for caching and unwrapping various config representations.

methods.name: defaultProvider
methods.description: Creates a default configuration provider that checks env vars, config files, and fallback configuration; supports caching.

methods.name: env
methods.description: Provides configuration based on environment variables AWS_MAX_ATTEMPTS and AWS_RETRY_MODE.

methods.name: ini
methods.description: Creates configuration from a specified ini file, optionally from a specific profile.

methods.name: unwrap
methods.description: Converts various representations of configurations into a ConfigurationInterface object, including callables, promises, arrays, and integers.
